item.title: Version 1.3.95
item.description:
- Fixed the Homepage tab not updating the site. Its Hero, Featured Adventure and Featured Lifestyle slots were saved to gallery-data/homepage.json, but nothing applied them to the home page, which is static HTML, so the hero stayed the old image. Save to Website / Publish now writes the slots into index.html: the hero image, and the Adventures and Lifestyle cards (image, name and badge).
- Uses right-sized self-hosted copies of each gallery's cover photo (2200px for the hero, 1200px for cards) under /assets/media, resolved from the gallery's own exported cover. Safe to run repeatedly.
- A hero chosen with Hero Images → Choose Image… is an explicit upload and still takes priority over the hero slot.
